changelog: Migrated notification delivery to Firebase Installation IDs (FID), with acknowledged registration and retry handling for improved device registration reliability.
Updated backend device registration and notification delivery to use the new FID-based system. Compatible backend deployment and app upgrade are required.
Improved OPD Booking and OPD Update referral-source handling so Direct/Self referral information is normalized and displayed more consistently.
Redesigned follow-up synchronization to be session-aware, city-specific, and event-driven, reducing the risk of stale background work running after a login change.
Follow-up refresh now considers the visit schedule, cancelled visits, Special Day Mode, and city eligibility to determine which data should be synchronized.
Added date- and app-version-aware sync checks so updated app versions can refresh follow-up data even when a same-day sync was already completed.
Improved APK verification and update installation using Android PackageInstaller sessions, including installation confirmation and status/failure handling.
Refined location-permission prompts to better reflect multi-city availability and avoid unnecessary repeated prompts during the same day.
Improved notification-card WebView measurement and layout handling.
Cleaned up follow-up age display by removing unnecessary trailing decimal zeros.
